note: `a\.b` is a bare single segment with an escaped literal dot, naming the same effective flat key as the quoted segment `"a.b"` (Sec 5.5, Sec 5.3.3): DuplicateKey compares fully decoded key content, independent of which spelling (bare-escaped vs. quoted) produced it. Note this is NOT the same as the dotted path `a.b` (no backslash), which would name a nested `{a: {b}}` instead and not collide at all.
